tex_content.html:
Proposition

↗ prop:connection-on-tensor-bundles 1. ch4:4.21

For every smooth vector or tensor field $F$, \[ abla ^2_{X,Y}F= abla _X( abla _YF)- abla _{ abla _XY}F. \]
Proof

\sketch Contract $ abla F\otimes Y$ in its final two slots to obtain $ abla _YF$, and contract $ abla ^2F\otimes X$ and then $Y$ to obtain $ abla ^2_{X,Y}F$. Applying $ abla _X$, using compatibility with contraction and the tensor-product rule, gives

\[ abla _X( abla _YF)= abla ^2_{X,Y}F+ abla _{ abla _XY}F. \]

Rearrange to obtain the formula.

□
